children: Bread Financial reported August performance: average loans grew 5.6% year-over-year and net principal loss rate improved to 6.40%.
Average credit card and other loans were $18,588m for August 31, 2026, up 5.6% YoY, signaling loan growth.
End-of-period credit card and other loans totaled $18,730m as of August 31, 2026.
Net principal losses were $101m for the month; net principal loss rate decreased to 6.40% from 7.57% a year earlier.
30+ day delinquencies fell to $885m and delinquency rate improved to 5.36% from 5.84% year-over-year.
